message:
WIP(spike): keepalive-r2 A -- the standby e2e run for the first time, 72/72 with an older host

First run of host_standby_admission_e2e_test (built but never run before the pause), on 569059f:
- two expectations were one too high: the FIRST session is admitted in the handshake loop ('first session by
  activation') and logs no `session epoch=... peer=new` rollover line -- only a later takeover does;
- the older-host case waited 8 x 400 ms for B's (absent) standby answer; this raw client does not acknowledge
  the host's control data, so the older host ended A as peer-lost (~6 s) before A's second select -- 3 tries.
- REMOTE60_E2E_DUMP_HOST_LOG (the test's own env) appends each host's log to a file: the evidence of a failing case.
Result: --old-host <9991b36 GNLinkStream> 72/72 x2 rc0 (coexistence, explicit activation/takeover, parked
peers' pings/re-admission/control/late activation untouched, bounds/Busy/lease, two relay stand-ins, the older
host ignores StandbyHello and keeps its session). Contract draft section 4 records it.

제품/테스트/문서: 테스트(standby e2e 기대값·시도 수·로그 덤프) / 문서(계약 초안 §4) -- 제품 코드 변경 없음
